1. Who we are

John CRM ("John CRM", "we", "us") is a customer relationship management platform for professional service businesses, including insurance and financial advisory practices, operated by BOSS SOFTWARE LTD, a company registered in Hong Kong ("the Service").

This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use and share it, and the choices available to you.

Contact: info@hkboss.com.hk · (852) 2485 2033 · Unit 2, 3/F, Block B, Hoi Luen Industrial Centre, 55 Hoi Yuen Road, Kwun Tong, Kowloon, Hong Kong

2. Our two roles: controller and processor

John CRM handles personal data in two distinct capacities:

  • As a data controller for Account Data: information about you as a user of the Service (your login email, name, password hash, workspace settings, billing records, activity records). We decide how and why this data is processed.
  • As a data processor for Customer Content: the data that you and your organization enter into or route through the Service about your clients and contacts (names, phone numbers, messages, uploaded documents, policy details, and similar). For Customer Content, you or your organization are the data controller, and we process it only to provide the Service under your instructions and our agreement with you. You are responsible for having a lawful basis (and, where required, consent) to collect and process your clients' data, and for responding to your clients' privacy requests.

3. Data we collect

3.1 Account Data (you as a user)

  • Registration details: email address, display name, password (stored as a salted bcrypt hash; we never store plaintext passwords), and preferred timezone and language.
  • Google sign in: if you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account email and basic profile identifiers.
  • Organization data: organization name, legal/contact information, logo, membership and role records, and team assignments.
  • Billing data: subscription and token purchase records, invoices, and adjustments. Payment card details are collected and processed by Stripe we never see or store full card numbers.
  • Connected account credentials: if you connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Telegram, Discord, WeChat, WhatsApp, or an AI provider key, we store the tokens/keys needed to operate that connection. These credentials are encrypted at rest (AES 256 GCM).
  • Usage and activity records: authenticated requests to the Service (endpoint, timestamp, status, IP address, active workspace) are logged for security and administration. Request bodies (message text, passwords, tokens) are never stored in these logs. Activity records are retained for a short rolling window (currently 14 days) before deletion.
  • AI usage records: model used, token counts, and billing attribution for AI features.
  • Support access records: if John CRM staff access your workspace in view as mode (see section 6), the session is recorded in an append only audit log, and an access log is visible to your organization's administrators.

3.2 Customer Content (data about your clients, controlled by you)

  • Client profiles: names, phone numbers, email addresses, dates of birth, addresses, timezones, tags, pipeline status, notes, and, where you use these features, insurance/MPF portfolio details.
  • Messages and attachments: conversations sent and received through connected channels (WhatsApp, email, Telegram, WeChat, Discord, website chat widget), including images and files.
  • Uploaded documents: policy PDFs and knowledge base documents you upload, stored in private object storage and served only via short lived signed URLs after an ownership check.
  • Website chat visitor data: if you embed our chat widget, visitors' pre chat form details (e.g. name, email) and messages are collected on your behalf.
  • Consent records: opt in/opt out status for mass messaging, kept as a durable ledger so that contacts who decline are never messaged again.

3.3 Cookies

We use strictly necessary session cookies to keep you logged in. We do not use advertising or cross site tracking cookies.

4. How we use data

We use personal data to:

  1. Provide the Service authentication, workspace management, message delivery and receipt, calendar scheduling, document storage and retrieval, and reporting.
  2. Provide AI features classifying inbound messages, drafting and sending replies, extracting text from uploaded documents (OCR), generating embeddings for document search, and generating content you request. See section 5.
  3. Bill for the Service processing subscriptions, token purchases, and usage based accounting via Stripe.
  4. Secure and operate the Service activity logging, fraud and abuse prevention, rate limiting, debugging, and platform monitoring (aggregate statistics).
  5. Support you responding to support requests, including consent gated view as access (section 6).
  6. Comply with legal obligations record keeping, responding to lawful requests from authorities.

We do not sell personal data, and we do not use Customer Content for advertising.

5. AI processing

The Service includes AI features that process message content and documents:

  • Message classification and auto replies: inbound client messages may be sent to third party AI model providers to classify the message topic and, where enabled by you, to draft or send a reply. Replies can be reviewed, edited, held, or disabled per conversation by your agents.
  • Document processing (OCR and retrieval): uploaded policy and knowledge base documents may be processed by Google Cloud Document AI (OCR) and Google Vertex AI (embeddings) so their content can be retrieved to answer questions. Documents transiting Google Cloud Storage for OCR are deleted after processing, with a 1 day automatic deletion backstop.
  • Model providers: depending on configuration, AI requests are routed to providers including OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Anthropic, and Google. If you supply your own API key ("bring your own key"), requests for that provider are made directly with your key.
  • No training: we do not use your data to train AI models. Our arrangements with AI providers are limited to inference (generating a response).

You are responsible for informing your clients, as required by applicable law, that AI assisted responses may be used in your communications with them.

6. Support access (view as) and transparency

John CRM support staff may, with a stated reason, access your workspace in a read only "view as" mode to troubleshoot issues. Safeguards:

  • Your organization can disable support access at any time in its settings; when disabled, new support sessions cannot start.
  • View as sessions are read only (no changes can be made), time limited (maximum 30 minutes), and every session is recorded in an append only audit log.
  • Your organization's administrators can see a log of John CRM staff access to your organization.

We may also disclose data where required by law, to protect the rights and safety of users, or in connection with a merger or acquisition (in which case this policy will continue to apply to previously collected data).

8. International transfers

Our primary infrastructure is in Singapore. AI and document processing involves transfers to providers in the United States as listed above. Where required by applicable law, we rely on appropriate safeguards (such as contractual data protection commitments with our subprocessors) for these transfers.

9. Retention

  • Account Data: retained while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterwards for record keeping, then deleted or anonymized.
  • Customer Content: retained under your organization's control while your subscription is active. On verified account/organization deletion, Customer Content is deleted, subject to the exceptions below.
  • Activity logs: rolling 14 day retention.
  • Billing and audit records: retained as required for accounting, tax, and dispute resolution obligations.
  • Executed contracts (where the contract feature is used): retained for at least 7 years after termination, in line with record keeping obligations.
  • OCR staging data: deleted after processing (1 day automatic backstop).
  • Backups: deleted data may persist in encrypted backups for a limited period before rotating out.

10. Security

Measures we apply include: encryption in transit (TLS); encryption at rest for stored credentials and API keys (AES 256 GCM with per purpose keys); salted password hashing (bcrypt); private object storage reachable only through short lived signed URLs after ownership checks; workspace scoped data isolation enforced at the query layer; role based access control; append only, tamper evident staff audit logging; and login rate limiting. No system is perfectly secure; we will notify affected customers of a personal data breach as required by applicable law.

11. Your rights

Depending on your jurisdiction (including under the Hong Kong PDPO), you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal data we hold about you, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to data portability.

  • Users: contact us at info@hkboss.com.hk to exercise rights over your Account Data.
  • Clients of our customers: because your data is controlled by the business you interact with, please direct requests to that business. We will assist our customers in fulfilling such requests.

We will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law. You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in Hong Kong, the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data).

12. Children

The Service is a business tool and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18 as users of the Service.

13. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be notified to organization administrators by email or in app notice before they take effect. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the current version.
